The dose of adrenaline is 10 to 30 micrograms/kg given intravenously (generally into the um- bilical vein) or by intraosseous injection. If neither of these routes are available, it may be given via the endotracheal tube; standard doses are probably ineffective10 and doses of up to 100 micrograms/kg may be required, although there is little evi- dence to support this.2,4,5 1.
